item.title: Wagging Tales from Mason County Animal Shelter
item.description: Meet Alice! A gentle and affectionate soul who is looking for her forever family. item.title: Sign, sign, everywhere a sign
item.description: If you are of a certain age – i.e., a bit ancient like yours truly – you will recall a hit song from 1971 from a one-hit wonder Canadian rock group that called themselves the Five Man Electrical Band. For those of you not familiar with the song, it was called “Signs” and it was a protest song, something that occurred with regularity back in those days. The song reached No. 3 in the United States, and topped the charts in Australia.

item.title: Hyperscale data center zoning map amendment application submitted
item.description: An application for a rezoning map amendment has been submitted for a proposed hyperscale data center in Mason County. The application is requesting an existing 2,080 acres of A-2 agricultural land to be rezoned to I-3 industrial.
